meta_description: Detection that keeps pace — intelligence-driven SOC with the boring parts (tuning, coverage) done properly.

blocks.x: Detection that keeps pace — intelligence-driven SOC with the boring parts (tuning, coverage) done properly.

A SOC's quality is decided by coverage and tuning, not dashboards. We build and operate detection programs grounded in MITRE ATT&CK: coverage mapping by technique, detection-as-code with versioned rules and CI testing, threat-intel feeds fused into hunt hypotheses, and a tuning cadence that cuts false positives quarter over quarter. Co-managed options give you our analysts and platform while your team retains decision authority and context.

For AI-era threats we add model-specific detection — prompt-injection and data-poisoning monitoring on AI endpoints, shadow-AI discovery, and agent-behavior baselining — plus OT coverage (IEC 62443-informed) where plants and grids are in scope. Every incident feeds the loop: post-incident detections are authored within a week, tested and shipped.
